Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 62 - July 2022

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components.

  • Mobility Service 
  • Added support for Linux OS/Azure to Azure – RHEL 8.6 and Cent OS 8.6 
  • Added support for VMware/Physical to Azure – RHEL 8.6 and Cent OS 8.6 
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery (Service) 
  • Support for configuring proxy bypass rules is now available for VMware and Hyper-V replications, using private endpoints. 

This update also provides bug fixes along with various security fixes for classic VMware/Physical machine protection scenario.

Learn more about the updates and get the download links.
